{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the highest sample_seq for each patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates, keeping the last (highest sample_seq)
deduped_data = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
print(f"Number of unique patient_id after deduplication: {deduped_data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows after deduplication: {len(deduped_data)}")

# Check if any duplicate patient_id remain
remaining_duplicates = deduped_data[deduped_data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Remaining duplicate patient_id: {len(remaining_duplicates)}")"}
